description:
The Thunder Frameset is made for riders who want more versatility, whether that means city streets,

mixed pavement, or light gravel. With a TIG-welded, double-butted Reynolds 725 steel frame, clearance

for wider tires, and mounts for fenders and racks, it gives you a solid foundation for a build that can

take you far beyond smooth pavement.

Lightweight Steel Construction.

The Thunder uses heat-treated, double-butted Reynolds 725 chromoly for a frame that feels both stable

and lively. Oversized main tubes and slim stays help keep weight down while giving the bike the strength

and responsiveness needed for a range of terrain.

Artisan Craft and Finish.

Every frame is hand-built by skilled artisans with roots in Japanese frame-building traditions.

You can see it in the alignment, the smooth welds, and the overall finish. The frame receives a

traditional wet-paint application followed by a clear coat, giving each color a deep, polished look.

Versatility by Design.

With room for wider tires and full rack and fender mounts, the Thunder is designed to expand your riding

options. The frame and fork include eyelets and bosses for utility and adventure setups. Removable

cantilever brake posts give you flexibility in brake choice, allowing options ranging from cantilevers

to mini V-brakes or V-brakes, depending on your needs.

Crafted for Real Use.

The Thunder features investment-cast dropouts, chromoly fork blades, and carefully finished TIG welds

throughout. It is designed to hold up to everyday riding while maintaining a smooth, responsive feel

that encourages longer and more varied routes.

TECH SPECS AND NOTES

Includes:

Frame, fork, complete headset, seatpost clamp, and bottle bolts.

Weight (55cm):

6.7 lbs.

Bottom Bracket Compatibility:

68mm English-threaded bottom brackets.

Steerer:

Threadless 1-1/8" steel steerer tube.

Note: The steerer tube length is precut to match your frame size and allow approximately

35–40mm of spacers between the headset and stem.

Headset:

Wabi Pro headset included with spacers, top cap, and installed star nut.

Dropout Spacing:

100mm front; 120mm rear.

Seatpost Compatibility:

27.2mm.

Brake Compatibility:

Front and rear removable cantilever posts.

Tire Clearance:

Up to 45mm, though some customers have made 50mm tires work.

Crankset Compatibility:

Accommodates certain track/messenger cranksets (tested to approximately 142mm Q-factor).

Note: The drive-side chainstay has a dimple to ensure crankarm spider and chainring clearance.

Eyelets / Bosses:

Two rear dropout eyelets, two front fork eyelets, fork-blade mount bosses for racks

(bolts included), and seatstay mount bosses (bolts included).

Cable Stops:

Integrated cable stops on the top tube. We recommend cable clips for a rear-brake installation.

Bottom Bracket:

Not included.

Brake Note:

The rear brake bridge is part of the frame for cantilever brakes. A front brake hanger must be

purchased separately for front cantilever brakes.

COMPONENT SIZING

The Thunder is designed around a 170mm crankarm, a 24mm setback seatpost, and stem lengths

that change with frame size and rider height. You can find our recommendations under

“Determining Bike Components Fit” on the sizing page. Using different parts may change the fit.

IMPORTANT NOTE ON COMPATIBILITY

We can only guarantee compatibility with the parts used on our complete bikes. If you’re planning

a custom build, feel free to reach out—we’re happy to share anything we know—but we can’t offer

refunds for issues with third-party components.
